title: Git-history activation replaces the whole commit lane on overlay-only drift
wanted_capability: An overlay-selector-only update path in activate_source: when the committed journal's source generation and P3 generation are unchanged and only the code selector / overlay eligibility drifted, swap the overlay selectors without clearing overlays and re-running the full activation (which replaces the entire (repo_id, commit) tantivy lane). Under active development the current behavior re-commits the same generation every ~2 minutes: prod showed rh_5f9fcb37 (transcript-search, 3,303 commits) re-committing continuously, oscillating the corpus doc count 604,168 to 607,693, keeping edge sidecars churning so the EdgeIndex watcher rebuilt a 1.5M-edge graph near-continuously (rebuilds up to 375s), re-enqueueing a constant 3,591-doc embed residue every 5-minute sweep, and growing the daemon heap to its 48Gi limit (4 OOMKills in 3 days).
missing_primitive: overlay-selector swap without whole-lane republication when source+P3 identity is unchanged
fallback_used: Reduced upstream churn instead: code-source pre-upload currency probe (commit a3dbeb11) stops unchanged-tree code generations, so overlay eligibility flaps only when the tree genuinely changes.
evidence: src/server/history_activation.rs:236-276 (no-op path whose committed_metadata_current check fails on code-selector drift)
prod blackboxd logs 2026-08-23: repeated 'typed Git-history activation committed' same ghs/p3, overlays toggling 0/1 every ~2min
notes: Mechanism pinned precisely (2026-08-23 overnight): activation_metadata_current (src/server/history_activation.rs:893) returns stale whenever current code selectors differ from journal.code_selectors, UNCONDITIONALLY, even when the overlay set is empty or the drift cannot change overlay eligibility (heads permanently diverged). Every code-source push for a member project therefore forces a full re-activation, and publication replaces the consolidated commit lane (observed corpus doc oscillation 604k to 655k, ~51k docs) and re-seeds a ~51-55k doc embed residue each cycle, whose refill+drain spiked the daemon to its 48Gi cgroup ceiling (touched 48.00GiB at 06:48:53Z). Fix shape: currency should recompute would-be overlay selectors under the current manifest and treat the journal as current when they equal the journal's overlay set; a changed set should update overlays without whole-lane republication when source and P3 identity are unchanged. Overnight mitigations in place: collector git_history/provenance paused for the two actively-churning repos (transcript-search, pg-flare) in the host collector config, collector interval 600s, embed refill no longer decodes visual payloads (5fe29a84).
